thread:
alex.m: Anyone seeing a sudden spike of GPU nodes NotReady in eu-west1? autoscaler reports provisioning failures.
sam: Yep noticed ~08:11 UTC. gpupool-preempt-3 showing multiple NotReady / NoSchedule.
ramon: looking at kubelet logs on one node: device-plugin crashlooping. paste: 
ramon: ```
E0421 08:11:12.987 deviceplugin.go:104] registration failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = plugin UID mismatch (plugin uid=1002, kubelet uid=1001)
```
alex.m: UID mismatch on the device plugin socket? Did we change anything in the driver-daemonset overnight?
sam: We rolled nvidia-driver 2.3.1 last night; it added an init container that chowns /var/lib/kubelet/device-plugins to root:1002 (packaging requirement). Old nodes expect root:1001.
ramon: cluster-autoscaler then marks nodes tainted deviceplugin-unhealthy -> NoSchedule. Autoscaler logs: "Scale-up aborted: pods pending due to taints: deviceplugin-unhealthy, no suitable node found."
oncall-bot: incident created INC-20260421-07 024-04-21T08:20:00Z 024  GPU nodes NotReady (eu-west1)
linda: Two mitigations: revert driver rollout (longer), or patch daemonset init to chown to 1001. Which is safer now?
alex.m: Patching daemonset to use 1001 is lower-risk and quicker. Revert would require reimage path for nodes that already applied the change.
ramon: patch command I'm about to run: 
ramon: ```
kubectl -n kube-system patch ds nvidia-driver -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"initContainers":[{"name":"chown-socket","image":"busybox","command":["sh","-c","chown -R 0:1001 /var/lib/kubelet/device-plugins || true"]}]}}}}'
```
sam: applied patch, ds is rolling. watching for first node to come back Ready.
ramon: after first pod restart device-plugin registered successfully, kubelet marked node Ready. rolling through pool now.
alex.m: autoscaler still failing to add new nodes because cloud GPU quota in eu-west1 hit. I opened CLQ-789 to request temporary quota increase.
linda: short-term: bump gpupool-preempt-3 autoscaler max nodes by +2 so it can provision within current quota map if possible. cost estimate if sustained ~ $5.8k/mo. revert when healthy.
sam: bumped max nodes. autoscaler retried and new nodes provisioning, joining cluster.
ramon: final status after rollout: gpupool-preempt-3 at desired 8 nodes, all Ready, device-plugin healthy. autoscaler stabilized, pending pod backlog cleared.
alex.m: action items:
- fix: make driver-daemonset chown uid configurable and default to kubelet uid to avoid mismatch across images
- infra CI: add preflight that validates device-plugin socket owner uid on representative node images before driver rollout
- runtime: emit clearer kubelet health logs for device-plugin UID mismatches and consider auto-fix option with warning
- autoscaler: surface clearer error messages for device-plugin taints and attempt cross-zone fallback before failing scale-up on quota errors
- cloud: follow up on CLQ-789 and document escalation path for GPU quota emergency increases

ramon: I'll add a runbook step: if device-plugin UID mismatch -> patch chown init to cluster kubelet uid, roll daemonset, watch nodes, coordinate quota if scale-up fails.
sam: I'll draft the postmortem with timelines and link CLQ-789 + the daemonset patch diff.
alex.m: incident closed after ~1h when all nodes stable. great teamwork :raised_hands:
